counterexample.note: The first search still starts at compress(startTick - 1), which is strictly below tick 100. Active liquidity is 1000 at tick 100 and 0 at tick 0, but the walk returns no tick. A second problem: with no initialized ticks, start 0 and end -100, compress(-1) is bit 255 of word -1, and the repair returns tick -10 without checking its bit.

summary: Rewrites the first search inside reset, but it still starts at compress(startTick - 1), so an initialized start tick is still skipped. When that position is bit 255 of a word, it also returns that bit's tick without checking whether it is initialized.
